prerequisites: The TFG must be defended and evaluated once it has been reliably confirmed that the student has passed all other subjects in the study plan and therefore has all the necessary credits to obtain the Degree, except those corresponding to the TFG itself.

learning_outcomes.text: General presentation: suitability to norms, legibility, writing, spelling, etc.
Logical and coherent structure in the representation of information, ideas, and arguments.
Interest of the author's points of view, judgments, and conclusions.
Quality of the presentation: appropriate use of media, correctness of oral expression, logical structuring, suitability to available time, etc.
Ability to interest and capture the audience's attention.

In the development of the bachelor's thesis, the student will generally work on all general competencies of the degree, from CG1 to CG9. Also, depending on the topic of the work, various specific competencies will be addressed. Specifically, in compliance with O.M. CIN/355/2009, it must be a work that synthesizes and integrates the competencies acquired in the teachings: TFG Competence.

The specific learning outcomes of the bachelor's thesis will vary depending on the assigned topic by the tutor but, as a general rule, will be directly related to the specific objectives of the degree.

These results will be reflected in the individual or group realization of the work, presentation, and individual defense before a university tribunal of an original project in the field of Engineering of a professional nature, and in which all acquired competencies are synthesized and integrated.

syllabus_topics: The contents of the Bachelor's Thesis will be framed within one of the work topics included in the area of Engineering in which the student has completed their studies, as indicated in the objectives of each degree.
teaching_methods: Tutorial sessions with the TFG tutor

assessment_methods.method: Monitoring of the student's face-to-face activities by their academic tutor
Final document submitted by the student
Public presentation of the work before the tribunal and subsequent debate with it

assessment_rules: Assessment, both ordinary and extraordinary, is carried out through a public presentation before a tribunal of three professors from the School. Although the Bachelor's Thesis may be part of a joint work, the presentation must be individual, and each student's particular aspects or contribution to the whole must be clear in the presentation. The final definition of the Bachelor's Thesis evaluation system will conform to the regulations defined in the Bachelor's Thesis Regulations of the Polytechnic School of Engineering.
